gags.description: Opening tab 'glovebox': the glovebox glyph pops confetti while waffles blow across in wind streaks; camera at REST_POSE then a jump cut closer.
Video-call tab: a pink left shoe in the main tile, its mouth flapping on each word, speech bubble 'what are the socks for?'; self-view tile shows a pair of socks.
New tab pops, cursor clicks it; search page types 'microwave beep sounds like a trap door'. Jump cuts every beat.

'fridge cam LIVE' tab: the fridge door swings open on 'fridge', a pickle leaps out and does parkour across UI (Add to cart button, a window's top edge, a tab strip, Subscribe button) with a dotted trajectory trail.
On 'Hold up' the fridge-cam video freezes with the pickle mid-air and a PAUSED badge; zoom punch, then whip up to the tab bar.
Tab-multiplication motif: 'brain.conf' tab shows every open tab as an attendee card ('attendees: N', -70% sticker); cursor clicks each new tab as it pops; jump cuts on beats.
Named tabs 'taxes' and 'tacos'; split screen, jump cut from TAXES to TACOS on the word.

DIY tutorial tab 'build a little boat out of boxes': eight cardboard boxes fly in and stack into a hull, a sail pops up and the box boat bobs and floats on the waves (step chips 1 boxes / 2 stack / 3 float).
Search tab 'cape vs cargo shorts', whip and jump cut.
Camera whips along the tab bar (10+ tabs) while the cursor clicks new tabs; search 'is yelling fore indoors ok'.

'GROCERY GP live' tab: a shopping cart with a rear wing and number 1 drifts sideways through a grocery aisle under a hanging AISLE 4 sign, tyre smoke, skid marks, speed lines, DRIFT! tag; race HUD with LAP 3/3, running lap timer, P1, km/h.
Same scene: zoom punches on 'Formula' and 'One', chequered flag waves in, the cart crosses the chequered finish line in P1.
Camera frames the bottom-left: an open wallet in the 'glovebox inventory' tab while ledger receipts rain down and land bottom-left. No receipts drawn by the section.
Camera pans left to right along the bottom edge, next to a small car in the inventory tab, following the ledger crumbs as they land in a domino line. No crumbs drawn by the section.

An OS window titled 'window' pops out over the browser: the dog behind a house window, half-lidded, raises one eyebrow on 'judgmental'; caption 'status: judging you'; a Clock window shows the time past 'standup: 9:00' with a LATE chip.
Hard cut to a wide REST_POSE shot: 48 sliver tabs, the dog window, speech bubble 'Man, even I know you're running late.', clock with blinking LATE. Holds to the downbeat, hard cut into the hook.

promotionCandidates: shot-list camera helper (beats -> poses with cut/whip/drift)
wf(lineId, word): word start frame by text
notes: Main browser at VERSE_WINDOW always renders tabCountAt(frame) tabs (flow mode), newest tab pops on its beat. Tab per scene = newest tab at scene start; at low counts tabs 0 and 1 navigate (glovebox -> shoe call, microwave -> fridge cam). Cuts only on beats or eighths; camera whips 6 frames. Literal lines: v1.02, v1.04, v1.08, v1.11, v1.15 (5); v1.12 and v1.16 are continuations of the cart and dog gags. KineticLine on v1.03, v1.05, v1.09, v1.10, v1.13 (5 of 16). Final bar is a wide REST_POSE shot of the dog scene; no transition out (hard cut on the hook downbeat). Fake clock reads 9:59-10:01 in the last bar vs 'standup: 9:00'.
